lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Grayson Boyd is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Grayson is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
d41: 🕯️ Grayson Boyd is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Grayson kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Grayson's gone." Stan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Grayson." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lillian blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Grayson Boyd, 41 days. The mantle passes to Lillian Gomez.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lillian Gomez, 23 — a florist. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Grayson — and Grayson is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Lorenzo, Paisley, Stan and 1 more speak for Lillian — "Grayson trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Lillian before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: 🏃 Jesse of Ashford walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Ashford has grain to spare — 2,583 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
d111: (Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)
d111: Snow by morning. (-8°C — Freezing) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
d111: The cold works on everyone — the village wakes aching from the deep cold.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
